summary: VisionWave Holdings filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026 disclosing an At The Market Issuance Sales Agreement with Aegis Capital Corp. as agent, permitting sales of up to $30.0 million of common stock from time to time. The shares are offered under a Form S-3 shelf (File No. 333-297939) declared effective September 1, 2026. No price per share, premium, or closing date is stated, and no board recommendation or advisor beyond Aegis is named. This is a routine equity shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch dilution pace and any selling-pressure overhang on VWAV and its warrants.
